title: State of the Feed — Week of November 16–22, 2026
content_html:
Verdict: worse, cycling

The shipped feed is 39.0% wanted, down 5.2 points from 44.2% 4 weeks ago. 3 finding(s) have been open 3+ weeks, and gate-misses got worse while open: reported every week, none closed.

Fix next (a session can do these)

  1. The gate threw away 38.0% of the rejects you wanted (7 week(s) open, 11.8 → 38.0, worse). Read the wanted rejects from the named sources in feedback/, find what in quality_charter.txt or the gate prompt rejects them, and fix that one cause. Done when: wanted share of rated rejects under 10%.
  2. 5 categories are unmeasured (7 week(s) open). Find why rotate_review_categories() leaves these categories short: a 12-a-day batch can give every category the floor. Fix the rotation, not the quota. Done when: every category has 20+ ratings in 28 days.
  3. Places you want that the pool barely carries (7 week(s) open). Trace the place's own outlets through a run (feed failing, filtered, or unanchored) and fix what keeps them out of the pool; add a source only if none exists. Done when: the place is in 1%+ of the pool.

Yours to decide or rate

  1. The feeds missed 84.7% of the week's headlines (2 week(s) open, 85.8 → 84.7, flat). Decide whether to build the headlines lane (TODO.md, roadmap B): ranked_out misses are the interest ranking working as designed, not a defect. Done when: under 50% of widely covered stories missed.

During the week of November 16–22, 2026, the aggregator completed 7 runs, fetching an average of 1,673 articles per run and delivering an average of 91 quality-passing articles per run. Across the week's deliveries, the category distribution was: ai-tech 126, news 105, climate 81, wellness 71, homelab 57, science 58, local 47, design 39, homestead 14, outdoors 14, and scifi 5. Articles are scored on a dimensional quality/relevance/local composite, weighted 0.25, 0.55, and 0.20 respectively. Over the trailing 14 runs, the pipeline's mean noise-to-signal ratio (articles fetched per article delivered) was 2.57, within a range of 1.15 to 3.37, indicating moderate filtering load with no notable outliers in the current window.

Feed changes this week included the addition of GN Civil Eats, GN Wildfire Today, GN Parents, GN Neuroscience News, Castanet.net (Canada), Climate Crisis (Coda Story), Common Dreams, FOSSIL HUNTRESS (listed twice), and GN Logging and Sawmilling Journal. Feed health shows 21 feeds with errors, including Civil Eats, GN Western Producer, GN AgWeb, Wildfire Today, and Neuroscience News; these warrant inspection, as several are recently added sources.

Feed discovery returned three identical candidates from passivehouseplus.co.uk ("Browse by category") with a score of 76.9, indicating a duplicate discovery result rather than three distinct sources. The candidate is a single feed to evaluate for addition, and the duplication suggests the discovery step should be checked for deduplication.
